title: How Do Batteries Make Electricity? 🔋
description: Ever wonder how chemicals inside a battery turn into electrical energy to power your devices? Discover the amazing scientific secret in under a minute.

scenes.say: How do dead chemicals turn into electrical energy capable of powering your phone?

scenes.caption: Electrodes and solution
scenes.say: A battery consists of a positive pole and a negative pole, separated by a chemical solution called an electrolyte.
An internal chemical reaction forces electrons to gather at the negative pole, trying to reach the positive pole.
Did you know? Electrons cannot cross through the internal solution, so the system forces them through the outer wire to power your device.
The negative pole is the source where electrons leave, while the positive pole is the receiver they are attracted to.
